rules.title: Bir Billing green tax
rules.detail: Charged on vehicles entering Bir Billing, motorcycles included. Rates were revised in early 2025. Known from a newspaper report; no official page was found.
rules.set_by: Special Area Development Authority, Bir Billing, with state government approval

source.title: Green tax in Bir-Billing revised to boost tourism infrastructure

history.change: State government approved a revised rate list that includes motorcycles.

rules.title: Bir: large buses barred from landing-site road, mornings
rules.detail: Large and multi-axle buses may not use the Bir Chowk to landing site road from 07:00 to 11:00. Motorcycles are not restricted.

source.title: Heavy Vehicles Restricted on Bir Chowk-Landing Site Road

history.change: Order reported, following a police report on traffic jams.

source.title: Heavy Vehicles Restricted on Bir Chowk-Landing Site Road

rules.title: Himachal entry toll for vehicles from other states
rules.detail: Charged at entry barriers under the yearly toll policy. Notified rates name passenger and goods vehicles only. The Chief Minister said two-wheelers stay exempt. The policy document was not opened.
rules.set_by: Department of State Taxes and Excise, Government of Himachal Pradesh

source.title: Himachal toll tax rates revised: Here's what you need to know

history.change: Toll Policy 2026-27 announced with higher rates from 1 April 2026; receipt reported valid 24 hours across the state.

source.title: Himachal Pradesh revises toll tax rates. Here's how much vehicle entry fee you'll have to pay from April 1

history.change: Chief Minister told the assembly the tax would be reviewed and that light vehicles and two-wheelers remain exempt.

source.title: Himachal Govt signals rethink on entry tax

history.change: Revised rates reported, with a lower rate for passenger vehicles from other states; two-wheelers not listed.

hazards.title: Khada Danda short cut to McLeod Ganj
hazards.detail: A monsoon landslide near Jogiwara washed the road out in August 2025. Traffic took a 13 km detour; riders were told not to use the remaining strip.

hazards.title: Sinking roads below McLeod Ganj
hazards.detail: The main road sinks near the army cantonment and Forsythganj, and keeps sinking after repairs.
